title: Topic 18
japanese_text: ＜司会アナウンス＞本<u>弁論</u>大会は、高校生<u>部門</u>と一般部門に分かれて行います。弁論の制限時間は４分で、時間を超えた場合は途中でも<u>打ち切ります</u>ので、<u>あらかじめ</u>ご注意ください。それでは、大会が始まるまで発表者は<u>控室</u>でお待ちください。
english_translation: [Moderator's Announcement] This speech contest will be divided into high school and general categories. Please be aware in advance that the time limit for each speech is 4 minutes, and if this time is exceeded, the speech will be cut off even if mid-sentence. Now, please wait in the contestant waiting room until the contest begins.
